meta.decision_rationale: The first quarterly Guardian review checks the governance model against the scenarios and flags any drift.
tradeoffs: Acting on weak signals risks overcorrection
rejected_alternatives: No formal monitoring (identity drift goes unnoticed)

confirming: Community governance participation rose, consistent with the Civic Hub scenario
contradicting: Digital-only usage grew faster than expected, echoing the Irrelevance scenario
emerging: Interest from two peer libraries in a federated catalog, echoing the Hyperlocal Powerhouse scenario

inconsistent: Fast-track lane briefly exceeded its 10% budget cap in one month
